group.div: Cancel only: Orders are set to Cancelled and stay in that state. The order form will show status "Cancelled" (not "New").
Cancel and Reset to Draft: When you cancel the orders, first orders are canceled and then reset to the draft state (form shows "New").
Cancel and Delete: When you cancel the orders then first the orders are canceled and then the orders will be deleted.
Cancel Delivery Order: Check this so the related delivery order (picking) is also set to Cancelled. If you leave it unchecked, the POS order will be Cancelled but the picking will stay "Done".
Cancel Invoice: When you want to cancel POS orders and invoice then you can choose this option.
If you want to cancel POS orders, delivery orders & invoice then you can choose both options "Cancel Delivery Order" & "Cancel Invoice".
